mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_CLM_HIST WHERE CLM_NO = #{clmNo} AND GLOBAL_TX_ID = #{globalTxId})
SELECT HIST_ID, CLM_NO, BEFORE_STAT_CD, AFTER_STAT_CD, EMP_ID, MEMO, GLOBAL_TX_ID, CHG_DT FROM TB_CLM_HIST WHERE CLM_NO = #{clmNo} ORDER BY HIST_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CLM_HIST (CLM_NO, BEFORE_STAT_CD, AFTER_STAT_CD, EMP_ID, MEMO, GLOBAL_TX_ID, CHG_DT) VALUES (#{clmNo}, #{beforeStatCd}, #{afterStatCd}, #{empId}, #{memo}, #{globalTxId}, #{chgDt})
